scientific_question: Does unchanged detector-native evidence distinguish the frozen Phase-3 Bass population transitions without original-stem Ground Truth at operation time?

detector.preprocessing: unchanged AudioPreprocessor stereo mean followed by peak normalization

native_evidence: onset timestamp and hexadecimal float representation
native onset-envelope value at the detected frame and hexadecimal float representation
unavailable_policy: Any quantity not carried or directly computed by the unchanged frontend is UNAVAILABLE; no score is reconstructed or invented.
association: The unchanged production builder candidate sequence is zipped in native order with the same frontend frame and envelope arrays; timestamp and strength equality plus exact canonical observation index/frame/sample/timestamp equality are mandatory.
serialization: canonical ASCII JSON: sorted keys, compact separators, no NaN, one trailing LF; runtime timestamps and nondeterministic identities excluded
descriptive_metrics: count/minimum/linear quartiles/median/maximum/mean/population SD of native strength
paired strength difference only at exact retained coordinates
strength of disappearing and newly observable coordinates
selected versus maximum nonselected strength in processed multi-candidate cells

prospective_discriminator_gate.YES: At least one fixed candidate-only criterion holds: absolute B-versus-D Cliff's delta is at least 0.474 (conventional large effect), or the frozen selected candidate is the unique native-strength maximum in at least 75% of processed multi-candidate cells.
prospective_discriminator_gate.NO: Absolute B-versus-D Cliff's delta is below 0.147 (conventional negligible effect) and unique-maximum alignment is no greater than 50%.
prospective_discriminator_gate.INDETERMINATE: Neither YES nor NO criterion holds, native evidence is unavailable, or authority/replay fails.
